result.summary: The home screen looks mostly polished; the only notable visual defect is the promo banner headline wrapping awkwardly so the last word sits alone on its own line.

issues.description: The green promo banner title wraps so that “3 free deliveries for you” leaves “you” isolated on a second line, making the headline look unbalanced.
issues.suggestion: Adjust font size, letter-spacing, or padding so the phrase fits on one line, or rewrite it to wrap more evenly.
